discussions.title: What makes a good first hackathon project?
discussions.body: I am joining my first hackathon this term. How do you choose a project scope that can be finished and presented well?

discussions.title: Share your portfolio for friendly feedback
discussions.body: Let us share one piece of work and one area where we would appreciate constructive feedback.

discussions.title: Which sensors are useful for a line-following robot?
discussions.body: I am comparing reflectance sensor arrays for a beginner robotics build. What setups have worked reliably in your projects?

comments.body: Start with one core user problem and a small working demo. A clear explanation is better than several unfinished features.
Including a short note about your design decisions makes it much easier for reviewers to give specific feedback.
A calibrated reflectance array is a good start, and testing it under different lighting helps avoid surprises.
